statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The one-way opening leg that lifted Tail last hour has been retraced: NDX is 29,013.63 (-1.01%) at 14:52Z, about 138 points above the 28,875.97 low and roughly 63% back through the opening range, and NQ is 29,047.50 at 15:05Z, some 100 points off 28,948.00. VIX has decayed to 15.80 at the bottom of its 15.75-16.06 day range. Tail returns to the low band while Stress stays elevated on the memory de-rating and the scheduled Iran announcement; the danger window is moved forward to 17:45Z-19:00Z around that announcement.
recommendation: Descriptive: the specific structure that raised Tail an hour ago was a failed floor followed by extension with only a 32-point pullback. That condition no longer holds. Two independent quotes corroborate the recovery, NDX 29,013.63 timestamped 14:52Z on Investing.com and NQ 29,047.50 timestamped 15:05Z on Yahoo Finance, against session lows of 28,875.97 and 28,948.00 respectively. Volatility is decaying rather than expanding: VIX 15.80 sits at the low end of a 15.75-16.06 range. Cross-assets remain unaligned with an equity stress event, with the 10-year yield 3.4bp lower at 4.70%, the 2-year at 4.24%, WTI down 2.22% at 85.13 and the Dow up 0.24% while the Nasdaq-100 is down about 1%. Under the fixed mapping that combination returns Tail to the low band. Stress is held elevated because the memory-complex de-rating is unresolved and the scheduled Iran announcement, the Nvidia report on 26 August and the Jackson Hole keynote on 28 August all remain ahead.
headline: Nasdaq-100: the opening one-way leg retraced about 63% and volatility decayed, so Tail returns to the low band with Stress still elevated
body: The checkpoint left open an hour ago has resolved to the upside. At 14:19Z the Nasdaq-100 was pinned near its lows with only a 32-point pullback against a roughly 500-point decline, which is the structure that denies a mean-reversion basket its exits. That structure has now failed. The cash index is 29,013.63 (-1.01%) at 14:52Z against a 28,875.97 low and a 29,094.72 open, so about 138 of the 218.75-point opening range has been recovered, roughly 63%. NQ futures show the same shape: 29,047.50 at 15:05Z on Yahoo Finance and 29,060.50 at 15:18Z on Investing.com, both about 100 points above the 28,948.00 low, inside a 28,948.00-29,480.50 day range. Two independent quote sources agree on level and low, so the retracement is observed rather than inferred. Volatility confirms the read: VIX is 15.80 (+4.43%) at 14:49Z sitting at the bottom of a narrow 15.75-16.06 day range, which is decay rather than expansion after a 1% index decline. Rates are unchanged in character, with the 10-year at 4.70%, down 3.4bp, and the 2-year at 4.24%, down 0.4bp; a bid bond market is not pricing a growth shock. Energy is lower, with WTI at 85.13 (-2.22%) and Brent at 92.71 (-1.78%), described by the source as profit-taking ahead of the Washington announcement. Dispersion inside equities remains the clearest evidence of what this session is: the Dow is 53,405.38 (+0.24%) at 15:26Z, the S&P 500 is 7,649.28 (-0.33%) and the Nasdaq Composite 26,023.20 (-0.60%), all against a Nasdaq-100 down about 1%. Shared delayed context collected at 15:25Z shows the same shape from a different angle: all seven tracked semiconductors lower with a mean of -3.31%, led by Micron at -7.12%, Intel at -4.07% and AMD at -3.28%, while five of eight megacaps are higher including Alphabet at +1.63% and Amazon at +1.38%. Treasury futures are bid across the curve and gold is up 1.06%. This is a memory and semiconductor de-rating with rotation into the rest of the index, not an index-wide liquidation, and it is the reason Tail falls quickly once the retracement appears rather than staying elevated on the size of the decline alone. Verified reporting attributes the chip weakness to Samsung's shareholder return plan disappointing in Seoul, to reports that Apple is evaluating memory from China's CXMT, and to Alibaba's 10.2 billion dollar share sale to fund AI spending. Separately, verified reporting confirms threatened 50 percent US tariffs on Canadian vehicles, auto parts and steel effective 1 January 2027 after trade talks broke down, and confirms that the Treasury Secretary is due to detail new Iran sanctions today, described in advance as an economic offensive aimed at third-country counterparties. Iran's security council has threatened Gulf tanker traffic in response. Those are scored as Stress and Confidence inputs, not Tail inputs, until a post-announcement price path is actually observed; the danger window is therefore narrow and placed at 17:45Z-19:00Z. The scheduled stack beyond today is unchanged: Fed Barkin and Case-Shiller tomorrow, Core PCE with the second GDP estimate and the Nvidia report on Wednesday, jobless claims and the start of the Jackson Hole symposium on Thursday, and the Warsh keynote with the payrolls benchmark revision on Friday. Confidence is high because the live evidence is current, corroborated across two independent quote sources, and complete across price, volatility, rates, energy, breadth and the calendar.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry a published Claude assessment. Through the 23 August afternoon and evening Tail was pinned at 4 with the EA_ON mapping while Stress drifted from 38 to 45 in a normal mode. Tail stepped to 15 at 22:00Z as the Asian technology decline began, then settled into a 7-12 band overnight. It rose to 19 at 07:00Z with Stress at 58 as the European session priced the memory complex lower in a trend-down mode, eased back to 11-13 in a mixed mode through the European morning, moved to 20 at 13:00Z when the cash open was pending, and reached 26 at 14:00Z, the only slot in the series outside the low and watch bands, when the open produced a failed floor and extension. The series therefore shows a single-hour escalation on observed structure rather than a sustained regime change.
outlookSummary: The conditional path holds the low Tail band through the remainder of the US session, easing to 12 at 17:00Z and lifting to 16 at 18:00Z and 15 at 19:00Z around the scheduled Treasury announcement on Iran measures, which is scored as a Stress and Confidence event because no post-event path has been observed. Conditional Stress peaks at 58 in that window and then decays through the close. Overnight the conditional series settles to a 10-12 Tail baseline, lifting to 14 at the Tokyo and Seoul opens where the memory read-across is repriced directly, and again to 14 at the European cash open. It then rises through the following European morning toward 17 in the hour containing the next 13:30Z US cash open and 18 in the hour containing CB Consumer Confidence and New Home Sales. Every forecast hour stays inside the low Tail band because forward structure is conditional by definition and no future price path is observed. Confidence decays from 85 to 58 across the horizon, reflecting distance from the current verified evidence rather than any expected deterioration in conditions.
